# Print LaunchAgent Status
[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)
| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `launchd.status.task` |
| Source | `02_core/runtimes/yaml/definitions/launchd.yaml` |
| Tags | launchd, lifecycle |
Prints launchd's view of the job (last exit code, run count, current
PID if running). Exits non-zero with a friendly message if the job is
not loaded.
